name: rindee
description: Connect a Rindee account to ChatGPT: look up calls, contacts, appointments, agents, campaigns, listings and Knowledge, and manage them.

interface.longDescription:
Rindee provides AI phone agents for service businesses, with three solutions on one account: an AI receptionist for incoming calls, online booking, and win-back calls to past customers. This app connects a Rindee account to ChatGPT, so you can review your calls and manage your appointments, contacts, agents and campaigns from ChatGPT.

Sign in with your Rindee account and choose the organization to connect. ChatGPT can then look up your calls, including each call's transcript and summary, your contacts and segments, appointments, staff, services, locations and time off, your agents with their instructions and tools, your campaigns and their results, your listings, the Knowledge your agents answer from, your phone numbers, call and appointment analytics, the activity log, and your balance and plan usage.

If you allow changes when you connect, ChatGPT can also set your business up from its website (details, opening hours, services and team), say where the details sent for a phone number from Rindee stand, put a number on an agent, ring your own phone so you can hear your agent, add, edit and delete contacts and segments, book, reschedule and cancel appointments, manage locations, services, staff and time off, create and edit agents and their tools, set up listings, add text to Knowledge and correct it, and pause, resume or end campaigns. What ChatGPT can do is never more than your own role in the organization allows.

ChatGPT cannot call your customers, start campaigns, change your plan, add balance, buy a phone number, manage API keys or webhooks, or change the organization's members. You can see and disconnect connected apps at any time under Integrations, Connected apps in the Rindee app.
capabilities: Set up your business from its website
Follow the details sent for a phone number from Rindee
Put a phone number on an agent, and hear the agent on your own phone
Look up calls with transcripts, summaries and outcomes
Find, add and update contacts and segments
Manage locations, services, staff and time off
Create and edit agents and their tools
Follow campaign results, and pause or resume campaigns
Report on calls and appointments, and read the activity log
Set up listings and sync them from your own system
Add text your agents answer from on calls
defaultPrompt: Set up an AI receptionist for my business
What do I still need to do before Rindee answers my calls?

positive.prompt: Show me my last 5 calls and how each one ended.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 5 most recent calls of the demo organization with date, contact, outcome and a one-line summary.

positive.prompt: What did the caller ask for in my most recent call? Quote the transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the newest call and answers from its transcript, quoting the relevant lines.

positive.prompt: Add a contact named Alex Review with phone number +61491570950.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, creates the contact and reports its name and number.

positive.prompt: Book Review Test for a general service next Tuesday at 10am at the Main branch.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the contact, branch and service, then after confirmation books the appointment, or reports that the time is unavailable and suggests another.

positive.description: Follow the details sent for a phone number
positive.prompt: Has my phone number been approved yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether the details sent for the number are being checked, need changes (and what to fix, on the Numbers page in the Rindee app) or were approved; when nothing was sent, says a number is got in the Rindee app under Numbers, Get a number.
Finds the running campaign and, after confirmation, pauses it and reports that no new calls will start until it is resumed.

negative.description: Placing a call is not supported
negative.prompt: Call +61400000123 right now and tell them their appointment moved.

negative.description: Starting a campaign is not supported
negative.prompt: Start my draft campaign and call everyone in it today.

negative.description: Billing and plan changes are not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Rindee plan and add $100 to my balance.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. It cannot change plans, add balance or buy phone numbers.

publication.release_notes: ChatGPT can now put a phone number on an agent, ring your own phone so you can hear your agent, bring in numbers from your Twilio or Telnyx account, say where the details sent for a phone number from Rindee stand, and share a link to listen to a call. More of your account can be read and changed too: contacts' extra numbers and emails, custom fields, agent versions, campaign batches and callbacks, and listing holds. Available in every country.
